name_is_adequate.description: true if the current name is adequate and no rename is suggested.

adequacy_rationale.description: If name_is_adequate=true: why the current name is still good.

suggestions.description: Rename suggestions. Empty array if name_is_adequate=true.

what_it_gains.description: What dimension or property it captures that the current name omits.

in_vivo_inspiration.description: If the name is inspired by a participant's exact words, quote them here. Empty string if not.
